title: "Second post"
description: "A test post with an explicit date different from the one in the name of the file."
date: "2026-02-25"
tags: ["demo"]
hide_table_of_contents: false
---
This post declares an explicit `date` (2026-02-25), which has to take priority
over the prefix `2026-02-20-` of the name of the file. It also overrides
`hide_table_of_contents` to `false`, different from the default `true` of the
Blog plugin, to confirm that the option can still be configured by item.
